column7: ApproveMFAReset audited some refusals decided before its transaction (self- or target approval, request already decided, machine or non-admin approver) but none decided inside it (request decided meanwhile, requester, approver or target changed on the row lock): the rolled-back transaction left no DENIED mfa.reset_approved row. auditMFAResetApprovalDenied now writes it through c.storage after the rollback; TestMFAReset_InTxRefusal_RequestDecidedMeanwhile_LeavesDeniedRow covers the lost decision (REVIEW-3838-DEEP-1 L2).
